name: binwalk
title: binwalk
description: Firmware analysis with binwalk: signature scan, extraction of embedded archives and file systems (SquashFS, CPIO, 7z, zip, gzip, xz, bzip2, LZO), entropy analysis and hex dumps. Files are read from the folder mounted at /work. Extraction writes to a writable folder mounted at /out, else to the container's /tmp (64 MiB, gone when the server stops). No network.

mounts.description: The folder with the firmware images (read-only is enough)
A folder for extracted files (tick writable)

notes: Extraction runs third-party extractors on untrusted input inside the container (no capabilities, no network). Mount /out writable only when you want the extracted files kept.
